text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 校园青春 · 春日教学楼庭院 · 纯环境.
Environment: An empty American high-school courtyard on a clear spring morning, cream stucco and pale brick academic buildings, covered walkway, simple wood benches, soft green lawn, distant sports field, a few young flowering trees, gently open central foreground. Everyday school warmth, no university grandeur. Original cinematic location photography for an intimate romance story. Vicky's aesthetic: bright high-key but retained highlight texture; cream white, pale gray, warm natural brown with restrained muted accent color; soft broad frontal/window fill, gentle low-contrast shadows; tactile plaster, wood, linen, glass and stone; very subtle film halation and grain, clean luminous air. Lived-in details without clutter, beautiful but plausible real location rather than showroom CGI. 35-50mm natural perspective, midground environment clearly legible with gently softer far depth. Strictly environment only: absolutely no people, bodies, faces, hands, silhouettes, distant pedestrians, reflections of people, animals, birds, fish, pets, mannequins, humanoid statues, character artwork or human figures on screens. No watermark, branding or captions. Keep clear usable space for later character compositing. Natural proportions, believable architecture, no fisheye, no excessive HDR, no greasy shine, no orange color cast.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent multi-angle image sheet with 4 clearly separated views of the same location. Show complementary eye-level views and relevant close details. Maintain the same physical positions of entrances, windows, stairs, furniture and landmark objects across views; no mirrored rearrangement. Small A/B/C/D labels only.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Use case: spatial production design. Create 多角度图 for 校园青春 · 春日教学楼庭院 · 纯环境. Image 1 is the geometric source of truth. Image 2 is original material and style reference. A 2x2 sheet of FOUR distinct eye-level camera views of the SAME ONE space: original forward direction, a lateral oblique view, a reverse view 180 degrees opposite, and the other lateral view. Labels A B C D only. Preserve ALL door/window/furniture positions; actually move camera, never mirror the building. Same material and lighting. Keep the plan footprint, doors, windows, fixed landmarks and circulation exactly consistent. Concept reconstruction, not measured construction. Match original color palette and rendering style, detailed legible clean image, landscape. NO people, animals, silhouettes or figures on posters. No fake measurements, no watermarks.
